subject: Lakshya / Ember GitHub profile header
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: an original wide pixel-art hero banner for Lakshya's GitHub profile. He builds Discord bots and web interfaces and edits movie/anime videos. This must look like a beautiful small 16-bit game scene, not a generic corporate portfolio graphic.
Style references: the attached two inventory objects are ONLY references for chunky square pixels, flat color clusters and clean stepped silhouettes. Do not depict those food or tool subjects.
Scene: a quiet developer/video editor's studio at night, shown straight on with a slight three-quarter view of the desk. A broad dark indigo room, two small CRT-like monitors on a wooden desk to the right, one displaying a few large teal code-line shapes and the other a violet multitrack editing timeline. A keyboard, headphones hanging from the desk, one small fern, and a warm amber desk lamp. Beyond a compact window, a simple low skyline and a few stars. No people. Keep the arrangement coherent and spacious.
Composition: very wide horizontal composition, about 3:1 aspect ratio, suitable for a GitHub README header. The illustrated desk and window occupy the right 55 percent. The left 40 percent is calm dark wall space with deliberately composed pixel typography, not a blank placeholder. The name should be the largest readable feature, integrated elegantly into the scene rather than a giant flat poster.
Text, verbatim: "LAKSHYA" (spell L-A-K-S-H-Y-A) in a crisp original block-pixel font in muted lavender on the left. Under it, smaller text "CODE / BOTS / EDITS". Do not add any other text, UI labels, logos, badges, signatures or watermarks.
Palette: dark midnight navy and charcoal surfaces, dusty purple, muted teal, restrained warm amber lamp light, a little desaturated wood brown. No white panels or cream background. Light text is allowed. Mostly dark, comfortable and legible, not flooded with neon.
AUTHENTIC CHUNKY LOW-RESOLUTION PIXEL ART. Work as a roughly 320 by 108 logical pixel composition shown enlarged with sharp nearest-neighbor-like blocks. Every visible pixel must read as a square of consistent scale. About 24 flat colors, clear simple clusters, stair-step silhouettes, 2-3 tone material shading, no blurry details. The detail should still read when the banner is displayed at 680px wide and 320px wide.
Avoid: painterly detail, smooth gradients, bloom, soft lighting haze, antialiasing, high-detail pseudo-pixel art, isometric miniature room dioramas, excessive clutter, cyberpunk billboards, huge generic geometric glyphs, default emoji, fake language logos, browser mockup cards, border around the entire image, outer frame.
Opaque illustrated background. This is a scene header, not a transparent icon.
packaging: Preserve source; encode the same pixels as lossless WebP without resizing, retouching, or painting.
publishing: Local draft only. Explicit approval required before push.
